newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN IPO - Aarvee Denims and Exports Ltd, Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN IPO - Aarvee Denims and Exports Ltd, Nov 4.

text.p: The following initial public issue (IPO) by India's Aarvee Denims and Exports Ltd is expected to be open for public subscription on November 4:

Aarvee Denims is coming out with this public issue to part finance a project to manufacture 5441 metric tonnes of cotton yarn. The company now has the facility to manufacture 8.16 million meters of denim per year. The entire output of the cotton yarn will be utilised for captive consumption for the manufacture of denim.
The project to be located at Sari in Ahmedabad is estimated to cost 303 million rupees with the following break-up:
- miscellaneous expanses and provision for contingencies 33.80 million rupees, and
- margin money for working capital 20.60 million rupees.
The proposed financing is through an issue of convertible debentures to the tune of 105 million, foreign currency term loans of 133 million rupees and rupee term loans of 65 million.
Out of the debenture component of 105 million rupees, promoters bring in 75 million rupees and the balance 30 million rupees is to be collected from the public.

Each debenture with a face value of 100 rupees have three parts. Part A of 30 rupees, Part B of 30 rupees and Part C of 40 rupees. Part A will be converted into three equity shares of 10 rupees on the date of allotment. Part B will be converted into three equity shares on the expiry of six months from the date of allotment. Part C of 40 rupees value will be converted into four equity shares on the expiry of 17 months but within 18 months from the date of allotment.

For the eight months ended May 1996, the company on a turnover of 321 million rupees made a profit after tax of 11.50 million rupees. On an equity capital of 165.80 million rupees the earnings per share was 1.54 rupees.
